name: dtc-inbox
description: Shows Dev Traffic Control answers waiting for your agent in Claude Code: a band, the /dtc pane, and a dtc_answers tool that returns them as delimited data. It never acts by itself.

dtcRoot.title: Records folder
dtcRoot.description: The folder Dev Traffic Control keeps its records in (the app's Settings show it).

hubDir.title: All-projects folder (optional)
hubDir.description: A session working in this folder sees every project's waiting answers. Leave empty and each session sees its own project only.

bandRefreshSeconds.title: Band refresh (seconds)
bandRefreshSeconds.description: How often the waiting count is recomputed.
